claim: Three statements in test_graph_structure.md do not match the shipped code: (1) line 209's dag_profile_builtin_exempt bullet says a profile declaring (and thereby exempting) requires_module 'fails profile validation as any fixed-point declaration does'; (2) the Setup paragraph (line 7) enumerates eleven DAGChecker fixture shapes and D10's 'Three further dag_profile_* fixtures' (line 207) lists exactly three, omitting a twelfth fixture; (3) D3's note (line 56) claims 'Fixture-tested cycles stop at two nodes (D2)'.
authoritative_source: schema/profile.go (Validate, decodeProfile) and the validator package's own test suite, which is what actually ships and passes.
evidence: (1) decodeProfile rejects fixed points only as unknown top-level fields; a node type named "module" declaring its own requires_module reference field (even cyclic: true) is well-formed inside node_types and Validate (schema/profile.go:355) has no check rejecting it — declared["module"] is set by the type declaring itself so the targets check at schema/profile.go:415 passes. TestREQ3_RequiresModuleNotShadowedByDeclaredField (validator/dag_checker_test.go:200) hand-builds exactly this shape and exists because Profile.Validate does not reject it. (2) validator/testdata/dag_profile_cyclic_per_declaring_type is a twelfth DAGChecker fixture, named nowhere in the Setup enumeration or the 'Three further' list, and is read by TestREQ3_CyclicExemptionIsPerDeclaringType (validator/dag_checker_test.go:249), which pins that the cyclic exemption is tracked per declaring type. (3) validator/testdata/dag_req_cycle/core/module.json is a three-node cycle (Feature A -> B -> C -> A), and TestREQ3_CyclePathIncludesAllNodes (validator/dag_checker_test.go:92) asserts all three titles appear in the reported path; D3's premise that no three-node shape is fixture-tested holds only for the module graph, not for every graph the leaf's sentence covers.
proposed_fix: (1) At line 209, replace the fixed-point rejection claim with an accurate statement: Profile.Validate does not reject a node type named "module" declaring its own requires_module field; schema.deriveEdges appends the frame's fixed requires_module edge unconditionally regardless, so the frame's cycle guarantee still holds (edgeActive resolves the shadow), but profile validation itself does not reject the declaration. (2) In the Setup paragraph, change 'eleven shapes' to 'twelve shapes' and add dag_profile_cyclic_per_declaring_type to the enumerated fixture list; under D10, change 'Three further dag_profile_* fixtures' to 'Four further' and add a bullet describing dag_profile_cyclic_per_declaring_type per TestREQ3_CyclicExemptionIsPerDeclaringType. (3) At line 56, qualify the claim to the module graph specifically, e.g. 'Fixture-tested module-graph cycles stop at two nodes (D2); the requirement graph has a fixture-tested three-node cycle (dag_req_cycle).'
